map.基于初始水分含量与水分蒸发量预测油炸食品吸油率（水分置换模型）: Predict the oil uptake of fried food from the initial moisture and the amount of water evaporated (water displacement model)

map.吸油率 = 吸油量 ÷ 油炸前重量 × 100%: Oil uptake rate = oil absorbed ÷ weight before frying × 100%
map.蒸发的水分被油部分置换，k 越大吸油越多（典型 0.5-0.8，深度油炸偏高）: Evaporated water is partly replaced by oil, so a larger k means more uptake (typically 0.5-0.8, higher for deep frying)
map.水分置换模型：油炸过程中水分蒸发腾出孔隙，油脂随后填充。吸油量 ≈ k × 水分: Water displacement model: during frying water evaporates and opens pores, which oil then fills. Oil absorbed ≈ k × water evaporated. Oil uptake rate = oil absorbed ÷ weight before frying × 100%. Lowering the initial moisture, shortening the frying time and lowering the oil temperature all reduce uptake.

map.油炸工艺水分置换规律应用: Applying water displacement patterns in the frying process
map.水分蒸发 = 炸前水 − 炸后水（按含水率折算）；预测吸油 = k × 水分蒸发: Water evaporated = water before frying − water after frying (converted via the moisture content); predicted oil uptake = k × water evaporated (k being the displacement coefficient); uptake rate = oil absorbed ÷ weight before frying × 100%.
map.炸前 100 g（含水 70%）、炸后 55 g（含水 40%）：蒸发 48 g: 100 g before frying (70% moisture) and 55 g after (40% moisture): 48 g of water evaporated, and taking k=0.65 the predicted oil uptake is 31.2 g, an uptake rate of 31.2% and about 56.7% oil in the finished product, which is high, so lower the starting moisture or shorten the fry.
map.油炸时水分受热逸出形成毛细负压，油被吸入孔隙，故吸油≈k×失水，降初水或缩短时间: During frying heated water escapes and creates capillary negative pressure that draws oil into the pores, so oil uptake is about k×water loss; lowering the initial moisture or shortening the time reduces the oil.
map.k 系数怎么取？: How is the k coefficient chosen?
map.随品类与工艺变（0.3–0.8），以实测标定；裹浆/预干处理可降低有效 k。: It varies with product and process (0.3-0.8) and should be calibrated against measurement; batter coating or pre-drying lowers the effective k.
